per_tail_by_duration_class.reading: Every unit carries exactly one tail, so 'per tail' and 'per unit' are the same column here. A steep column means the tail count is a proxy rather than a cause.

proportionality.reading: The tail cell holds the transport unit fixed and adds one tail per window, so it prices a tail with zero new boundaries. Scaling its per-tail cost to OBS-E1's 5,122 tails predicts the observed PERSON movement; what the 3,529 extra transport boundaries add on top is the residual.
